readPolicy: Read actual undo/redo stack depths and one bounded page (at most 32) of labelled entries under the existing current-owner dispatch lock. Entries are chronological: done entries oldest first, then the redoable ones nearest first; the cursor is undoDepth. The label is the display name of the command family or kind that created the entry. Optional offset/limit select the page (default: a window starting up to 20 entries before the cursor). Exact current revision and snapshot pins required; retained older snapshots refuse stale_revision. No mutation, revision publication, notification, read receipt, mirror or history copy. The jump behind a click is command.document.object.undo/redo with an optional steps count (one restore, one new revision), owned by native.object.

resourceBoundary.policy: Bounded original request bytes and complete correlated response; unsigned safe integer depths, at most 32 entries of at most 32 characters.

examples.label: Current native owner history; replace example pins with actual discovery snapshot
